baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive sequence يُعْرَفُ ... فَيُؤْخَذُ links recognition through سِيمَاهُمْ directly to bodily seizure at النواصي والأقدام.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visible trace resolves the offenders' identity, then the same exposed body supplies an anterior grip and a locomotor grip. Recognition is indexical rather than investigative, and capture converts legibility into restraint.

activation_trace.role: Recognition by a trace supplies the inference from visible evidence to identified persons.
The offense sense fixes the recognized group as culpable agents rather than merely conspicuous bodies.
A visible identifying mark provides the body's readable index.
Capture turns successful identification into custody.
The forelock is a literal control point whose seizure governs the body's front.
The stepping foot is the second literal control point and disables locomotion.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply reports that offenders are recognized and arrested.
changed_reading.after: The body is both identifier and restraint surface: its trace makes identity readable, and its front and means of motion become handles of capture.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مجرمون, يؤخذ, نواصي, and أقدام permit a sequence from acquired action to accountability and the reversal of forward agency.
baseline_models.mechanism: The offenders have earned or caused an offense; recognition borders on unavoidable acknowledgment, and taking them to account reverses the agency concentrated in the directing front and advancing feet. What formerly initiated movement becomes what can be controlled.

activation_trace.role: Earning and causing make criminality an acquired trajectory rather than a static label.
Acknowledgment or yielding shadows recognition with compelled self-disclosure.
A sign read by discerning observation carries the acquired trajectory onto a legible surface.
Taking someone to account converts earned action into liability.
Forelock control arrests the body's directing front.
Bold forward undertaking locates the agency now reversed in the feet.

changed_reading.before: Seizure is an external force applied to passive offenders.
changed_reading.after: Seizure is a reversal of their own acquired and forward-driving agency: the faculties by which they advanced become the points by which they yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus roots themselves juxtapose جرم as cutting or harvest residue, سمة as a marked gathering season, أخذ as taking possession, and a body grasped at its extremities.
baseline_models.mechanism: A harvest schema coexists with the legal one. A cut or dried yield is distinguished at its season, gathered into possession, and handled as bodily mass from its leading ends; the offenders appear as a sorted punitive crop.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and harvesting supply the model's decisive material operation.
Harvest residue gives the offenders a dry, gathered aftermath rather than only a legal classification.
A marked gathering season supplies timing and sorting for the harvest operation.
Taking into possession supplies collection after cutting.
Bodily mass lets the agricultural image return to the human bodies actually seized.
The leading edge supplies an extremity by which the gathered mass is oriented and handled.

changed_reading.before: Mujrimun is only a juridical class undergoing arrest.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing the juridical sense, the class also resembles a marked, cut, and collected yield at the moment of punitive sorting.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collocation of recognition, bodily جرم, visible سمة, and seizure allows the body to function as an exterior record of an interior condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Criminal condition is not merely announced by an attached badge. It becomes surface feature, color, or readable bodily state; recognition therefore resembles diagnosis, and seizure follows disclosure already carried by the person.

activation_trace.role: Visible facial or terrestrial features establish recognition through exposed morphology.
Bodily frame makes the person, not an external dossier, the record-bearing medium.
Clear color supplies one possible mode by which condition becomes visibly legible.
Observation of a sign supplies the act of reading the somatic record.
A condition taking hold in the body supplies the inside-to-surface transition inferred by the model.

changed_reading.before: The marks are external labels attached to already known offenders.
changed_reading.after: The offender's condition has become somatically legible; the body discloses the identity for which it is then seized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement from teaching to البيان turns the focus mark from a mute stain into a readable sign. Recognition becomes a nonverbal disclosure in the same semiotic order as meaning made clear by speech or indication.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing trace that guides toward its object supplies the surah's early sign-reading logic.
Meaning disclosed through speech or sign makes an embodied mark capable of functioning as البيان.
Recognition by trace receives the contextual semiotic mechanism.
The observed sign becomes a nonverbal statement of condition.

structural_cues: 55:2 and 55:4 establish teaching and clarification before 55:41 presents recognition without an identifying speaker.
The focus passive sequence lets the sign disclose before any agent of interrogation is named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies teaching, a distinguishing trace, clarification by sign, and focus recognition by mark; I infer that the bodily mark operates as nonverbal bayan. A live alternative is an externally assigned badge with no communicative function.

changed_reading.before: The mark merely singles offenders out from a crowd.
changed_reading.after: The mark communicates their condition: embodied recognition is a severe counterpart to the surah's opening gift of making meaning clear.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic calculation and the command to maintain a just measure make the body-mark resemble a balance reading. جرم as earning supplies the input, سمة displays the result, and أخذ as accountability settles the measured deficit.

activation_trace.role: Counting and calculation establish an exact rather than impressionistic order.
The balance of justice supplies the evaluative instrument behind the displayed result.
Justice constrains the measurement so recognition is not arbitrary stigma.
Short measure supplies the specific imbalance that returns as liability.
Earning supplies accumulated conduct as the balance's input.
The discernible mark externalizes the measured result.
Taking to account converts displayed imbalance into enforcement.

structural_cues: 55:5 moves from celestial bodies to calculation; 55:7-9 repeats الميزان and prohibits deficient measure.
55:41 orders mark, recognition, and seizure as result, reading, and enforcement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, just weight, prohibited short measure, earning, mark-reading, and account-taking; I infer that the mark is the body's balance readout. Alternatively, cosmic measure and penal identification may remain parallel but causally unrelated images.

changed_reading.before: Recognition precedes an otherwise unexplained punitive grab.
changed_reading.after: The visible body is the display of a completed moral measurement, and seizure is enforcement of the imbalance the offenders earned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier plant sequence distinguishes protected fruit or grain from its fragmented husk. It activates the focus's جرم cutting and residue branches so that marked seizure can look like an anti-harvest: persons are sorted as the dry aftermath of what they cultivated.

activation_trace.role: The plant casing supplies an intact containing form before harvest.
Seed that grows and bears grain supplies cultivated yield.
Fragmented grain husk supplies the discarded side of sorting.
Cutting and harvesting transfer the plant operation into the offender noun.
Dry harvest residue aligns the offenders with aftermath rather than nourishing grain.
A marked gathering season supplies readiness for sorting.
Taking into possession completes the gathering action.

structural_cues: 55:11-12 presents fruit casings, grain, and husk as a compact material sequence.
The focus itself moves from a marked class to collective taking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plant containers, grain, husk, and focus branches of cutting, residue, season, and collection; I infer a punitive sorting harvest. The live alternative is that جرم carries only its ordinary offense sense and the agricultural sequence does not reactivate its cutting history.

changed_reading.before: The offenders form a legal group selected for punishment.
changed_reading.after: They also appear, exploratorily, as a cultivated outcome now ripe for adverse sorting: marked, cut off, and gathered like unusable residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between universal disappearance and the remaining divine face or forward aspect gives the focus's forelock and feet an orientational force. The mortal body's own front, leading edge, and means of advance are seized, while the enduring orientation belongs elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Cessation after continuance supplies the fate of every embodied orientation on earth.
Continuance supplies the contrastive persistence against which bodily seizure is read.
Face and forward aspect establish an enduring orientation that contrasts with the captured human front.
The forelock localizes the mortal body's front as a point of control.
The leading edge extends capture from anatomy into orientation.
A grappling hold supplies the force that collapses the offender's own forward axis.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 opposes the disappearance of all on earth to the remaining وجه.
55:41 later names the body's front hairline and feet as paired seizure points.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mortality, enduring face or forward aspect, and capture of forelock and leading edge; I infer a contrast between derivative human orientation and enduring divine orientation. Alternatively, وجه and the later body parts need not form a spatial opposition.

changed_reading.before: Forelocks and feet are two practical anatomical grips.
changed_reading.after: They remain literal grips while also marking the collapse of the offender's self-directed, future-facing bodily axis.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge to pass beyond the cosmic bounds establishes an outward vector, makes coercive authority its only possible means, and then removes assistance. The focus capture at forelocks and advancing feet is the terminal counter-vector: direction and locomotion are both pinned.

activation_trace.role: Passage through to the other side supplies the attempted escape vector.
Power and authority supply the only stated enabling force for passage.
The negated prospect of aid closes off external rescue.
Bold forward advance locates the failed vector in the feet.
Forelock seizure captures the directing end of the body.
A restraining grappling hold supplies the counter-force that terminates motion.

structural_cues: 55:33 repeats the penetration verb three times as challenge, command, and negation.
55:35 denies successful defense; 55:41 then specifies how bodies are physically controlled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted penetration, required authority, absent aid, advancing feet, and a grappling hold; I infer that 55:41 is the endpoint of a failed escape trajectory. A live alternative is simple narrative succession with no vector reversal encoded in the seizure points.

changed_reading.before: The body is seized after judgment in a static arrest scene.
changed_reading.after: The seizure dynamically cancels attempted flight: the directing front and advancing base are caught as the outward vector folds into custody.

context_deltas.mechanism: When the ruptured sky becomes rose-colored and coating-like, cosmic truth appears as transformed surface. The focus then lets bodily جرم become clear color and readable mark, miniaturizing cosmic surface disclosure on human bodies.

activation_trace.role: Rose and red coloration make visible transformation the sky's disclosure mode.
Oil or coating supplies a materialized, readable surface rather than an abstract color.
Clear color transfers surface disclosure from cosmos to bodily جرم.
The visible identifying mark converts transformed surface into identity evidence.
Recognition through exposed features completes the body-as-disclosing-surface analogy.

structural_cues: 55:37 transforms the sky's appearance; after one refrain and the no-questioning verse, 55:41 identifies transformed human appearance.
Both scenes use passives or state changes that foreground what becomes visible rather than who inspects it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a colored, coating-like sky and focus branches of clear bodily color, visible mark, and exposed feature; I infer a scale analogy in which surfaces reveal hidden judgment. Alternatively, the cosmic simile and bodily marks may be independent visual scenes.

changed_reading.before: Only offenders bear visible marks in an otherwise ordinary visual field.
changed_reading.after: Their marked bodies participate in a wider unveiling in which even the sky becomes a truth-bearing surface; the body is a local judgment surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding negation of questioning removes interrogatory speech. ذنب supplies both offense and a trailing end; the offense leaves an aftermath that can be read as سمة, so recognition itself replaces testimony and leads directly to account-taking.

activation_trace.role: Questioning and request define the verbal procedure explicitly negated before the focus.
Sin supplies the culpable content that would ordinarily be asked about.
A tail or trailing end materializes offense as an aftermath that follows its agent.
Recognition by trace supplies the nonverbal evidentiary procedure.
A sign read by observation makes the trailing aftermath legible.
Taking to account follows the evidence without an intervening examination.

structural_cues: 55:39 says no human or jinn is questioned about the offense; 55:41 supplies recognition by marks after the refrain at 55:40.
The focus uses two passives and no quoted speech, compressing evidence and enforcement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated questioning, offense as sin and trailing end, recognition by trace, observed sign, and account-taking; I infer that embodied aftermath substitutes for testimony. The main alternative is that questioning is unnecessary because of prior knowledge, while the marks only help attendants sort bodies.

changed_reading.before: No questions are asked because the offenders are already known, then visible marks help locate them.
changed_reading.after: Their offense has followed them into a readable bodily aftermath: the mark is evidence, answer, and identification at once, collapsing inquiry into recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: After seizure, the same offenders are identified through their denial and made to circle between the denied fire and fully heated water. Linear advance is converted into compulsory orbit; their repeated refusal to recognize becomes the identity by which they are recognized.

activation_trace.role: Contradiction of truth supplies the repeated act that defines the group after the focus.
The repeated offender noun explicitly carries the focus group into the denied destination.
Circling around converts free forward motion into a closed punitive path.
Hot water supplies one material pole of the compulsory circuit.
Reaching full time or maturity makes the heated pole an arrived culmination rather than a passing state.
Bold forward undertaking supplies the linear agency that the orbit reverses.
The grappling hold is the pivot that redirects advance into imposed circulation.

structural_cues: The refrain of denial occurs immediately after the focus at 55:42, then 55:43 names the same offenders as deniers.
55:44 places their movement between two poles rather than toward an exit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, recurrence of the offender class, circling, fully heated water, forward undertaking, and restraint; I infer that seizure redirects denied truth into a closed experiential circuit. Alternatively, recognition, seizure, and circling are successive punishments without a reciprocal motion pattern.

changed_reading.before: The offenders are seized and transported to a punishment they had denied.
changed_reading.after: Their denial becomes their recognizable identity, and seizure converts self-directed advance into an orbit around the very reality they refused to acknowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later equation of good action with good return exposes a reciprocal law. Its dominant جزاء branch answers action with its consequence, while the packet's split cutting branch adds ripeness for shearing; together they strengthen both the focus's earned-liability model and its harvest shadow.

activation_trace.role: Answering an act with its recompense supplies the explicit return rule.
The non-dominant split target's time of ripeness for cutting activates a harvest timing overlay.
Doing good and its repeated return instantiate the positive side of reciprocity.
Earning supplies the negative action whose consequence returns.
Harvest cutting receives support from the split recompense inventory's ripeness branch.
Prior deed or merit that has gone ahead supplies the temporal object of return.
Account-taking enforces the returned consequence.

structural_cues: 55:60 repeats الإحسان on both sides of an exclusive recompense equation.
The focus likewise places acquired جرم before taking, allowing action and consequence to be read in sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal recompense, repeated good action, a split ripeness-for-cutting branch, earning, prior deed, and account-taking; I infer that 55:41 is a negative-side return and punitive harvest. A live alternative confines 55:60 to positive reward and treats the split cutting target as form-distant rather than operative.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes one-way punishment imposed after identification.
changed_reading.after: It also belongs to a reciprocal economy: acquired action comes back as account, while the exploratory harvest layer renders the matured outcome ready to be cut and gathered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because أقدام is grammatically the bodily plural 'feet,' and the prior-deed branch must not replace that sense. It remains anchored in the same focus root, جرم as earning, أخذ as account, and 55:60's recompense rule. Render it only as a metonymic echo: the feet are literal while what they sent ahead shadows the means of seizure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الأقدام remains anatomical but activates قدم as precedent deed or standing that has gone ahead.

activation_trace.role: The bodily foot secures the required literal reading.
A deed or standing gone ahead supplies the metonymic echo within the same root.
Earning links prior action to present liability.
Recompense answering action supports the return of what went ahead.

changed_reading.before: They are physically seized by their feet.
changed_reading.after: They are physically seized by their feet, with an exploratory echo that their own antecedent deeds are what have carried them into seizure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading depends on the packet's split mapping of س م و at 55:78 into both name-indication and visible-mark inventories, so it is a deliberately form-distant activation, not an etymological claim that اسم and سيمة are identical. It remains validly anchored in the focus's mark and the finale's citable branches. Downstream prose should call it a counter-signature or sound-and-branch resonance, never a lexical equation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بسيمـاهم makes offender identity legible by a borne mark, while the final ayah makes the enduring divine name an indication joined to fixed, growing good.

activation_trace.role: The offenders bear a visible identifying trace.
The name functions as elevation, mention, and indication at the surah's close.
The non-dominant mapped mark branch creates the packet-authorized resonance between name and identifying trace.
Fixed, growing good contrasts the final name's generativity with the offenders' punitive marks.

changed_reading.before: The offenders' marks are local stigmas with no relation to the surah's closing name.
changed_reading.after: Their marks can be heard as negative counter-signatures within a surah that closes on the enduring, generative indication of the divine Name.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because forelocks and feet are concrete body parts, while the elite, headman, and vanguard branches are socially displaced. It stays anchored in three focus roots and preserves the anatomical model. Render only as a secondary social-body topology: seizure reaches identifiable leadership, the selected front rank, and the advancing base, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Recognition plus النواصي والأقدام can superimpose a social body's known heads, elite forefront, and moving rank upon the literal seized body.

activation_trace.role: A headman through whom a group is known supplies recognizable social leadership.
The chosen elite or select forerunners map the bodily forelock onto a social forefront.
A vanguard or leading edge supplies the social body's forward rank.
Literal stepping feet retain the bodily base beneath the social overlay.

changed_reading.before: Each offender is seized at two anatomical points.
changed_reading.after: The literal seizure may also totalize a criminal social body, reaching its known heads and elite forefront through its advancing base.

strongest_changes: The no-questioning sequence turns the mark into nonverbal evidence: offense trails its agent into a readable bodily aftermath.
Calculation and just measure recast the mark as an embodied balance result and seizure as enforcement of earned deficit.
The failed-penetration challenge makes forelock-and-feet capture the terminal reversal of outward agency.
Plant imagery and the split recompense inventory preserve an exploratory anti-harvest in which matured action is cut, sorted, and gathered.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots already contain legal, bodily, directional, chromatic, and agricultural mechanisms; context does not collapse them but activates different circuits. Especially productive were the immediate shift from no questioning to recognition, the later recurrence of the offenders inside a closed orbit, and two split-root inventories that support contained name/mark and recompense/harvest resonances.
remaining_uncertainties: The agricultural and cosmic-surface models may be deliberate cross-domain mechanisms or only branch-level resonances.
Questionless recognition may arise from prior knowledge rather than from the body's mark functioning as sufficient evidence.
The prior-deed echo in أقدام and the final name/mark counter-signature must remain overlays and cannot replace the ordinary grammar.
The social-body topology is traceable but substantially more distant than the physical capture model.
